text:
sarah (sales): Hey team — Spectral (reseller) asked for a fast checklist: can we confirm required artifacts for a joint POC? They want tenant provisioning, SSO, and a pricing ballpark.

maria (partner-eng): Spectral needs: staging tenant, dedicated quota, SSO (SAML), and basic telemetry export. Also they asked about HSM for keys.

aj (solutions): For pricing ballpark — for a 2-week POC with ~200k tokens/day we usually suggest a short reserved commit on Dedicated or hosted credits + a dev discount. I can draft numbers.

timo (infra): SAML flow is fine. For HSM — Private or Dedicated with customer-managed KMS works; on-prem HSM is a longer lead time.

sarah (sales): Spectral asked if we can host in eu-west for latency. Is that supported on Dedicated?

timo (infra): Yes, we have eu-west capacity for Dedicated. For Private we need network prep. If they want HSM + VPC peering it's a 2-3 week ops window.

maria (partner-eng): Question from their security team: do we provide SOC2 cert and do we allow customer-supplied paper for penetration test?

aj (solutions): SOC2 Type II yes. For pen tests we have a standard process — they can submit an authorization form. I'll attach the doc link in the follow-up.

sarah (sales): Can someone post the minimal entitlement list we need to provision the tenant? Spectral expects a one-pager.

timo (infra): Minimal entitlement checklist: 1) company domain for SAML, 2) list of admin users, 3) peering IPs (if vpc), 4) expected qps + token/day, 5) telemetry export recipient (s3/kinesis), 6) KMS ARN if using customer keys.

maria (partner-eng): I'll format that. Also add runbook: can we add an automatic fallback policy to cheaper model for burst protection? Partner asked about cost predictability.

aj (solutions): Yes — we can attach a routing policy: primary model x, fallback model y, with a per-minute burst cap. That is typically added in the rollout config: 

```json
{"routing": {"primary": "redwood-xl-8k", "fallback": "redwood-quant-4k", "burst_limit_per_min": 200}}
```

sarah (sales): Nice. For pricing — can you give a quick sample: 200k tokens/day for 14 days on Dedicated reserved vs hosted pay-as-you-go?

aj (solutions): Rough quick numbers (very ballpark): Hosted PAYG ~ $0.0009/token -> ~ $25k for the POC. Dedicated (short-term commit + discounted rate) might be ~40% cheaper if we can commit capacity; plus setup fees if they need VPC/HSM. I'll follow up with spreadsheet.

Spectral Rep (external): @sarah thanks — HSM isn't mandatory for POC, but we need KMS integration. Can you share the SAML metadata sample?

maria (partner-eng): Put this in the runbook — SAML metadata sample attached (I'll DM). Also include test accounts: 2 admin, 4 read-only.

ops-bot: Deployed staging tenant 1746605342-spectral-staging (tenant-id: spec-stg-42) — please verify SAML metadata and entitlement list.

sarah (sales): Ops bot — awesome, can we enable telemetry export to their S3 preview bucket? They provided ARN: arn:aws:s3:::spectral-poc-telemetry.

timo (infra): We need a signed agreement for cross-account access. Maria, can you trigger the entitlements checklist and legal template?

maria (partner-eng): On it. I'll open a ticket with legal + infra and post updates here. Also scheduling a quick 30m kickoff with Spectral tomorrow 10:00am PT.

sarah (sales): Thanks all. AJ — can you prepare the pricing spreadsheet and a 1-slide summary for Spectral before kickoff?

aj (solutions): Yup. Will post numbers by EOD and include fallback routing config and cost delta.

maria (partner-eng): Legal ticket created: LEG-7891. Infra ticket: INF-4562. Will add link to the runbook once infra confirms SAML metadata binding.

sarah (sales): Great. If any blockers pop up (network egress, HSM lead times), flag here ASAP. :thumbsup:

Spectral Rep (external): Appreciate it — we'll come prepared with domains and admin list at kickoff.

maria (partner-eng): Closing the loop — added the entitlement checklist to the ticket and uploaded the sample SAML metadata. Leaving this thread open for updates.
